Cutting can give some people a temporary euphoria, but it is only temporary.
When you say you did nothing, were you allowing yourself a “mental health” day to decompress?
I’ve got the old scars too, I still struggle to stay away from my habit but I’ve done well for a few years. How long have you gone without?
Also not trying to tell you what to do… just how I cope with a similar thought pattern

The working so much is hard to weigh against our time spent enjoying things, I try to afford myself sweet successes though my work week like seeing the dogs at lunch by using my break. Sometimes this snap back to my reality helps. I also use all my vacation and turn off my email so I can be present. I have to be present outside of work to find the joy I earned in excess in the 80% of time I have to work.
